night-violet.$description: Night Violet — Page background, dark card surfaces, footer and section canvas

void-plum.$description: Void Plum — Inverse text on light treatments, occasional dark text on pale surfaces

soft-quartz.$description: Soft Quartz — Primary headings, buttons, borders, icons, input text, dominant foreground

muted-steel.$description: Muted Steel — Secondary heading tone, brighter muted copy over Night Violet

ash-lilac.$description: Ash Lilac — Body copy, navigation links, supporting labels, low-emphasis UI text

dim-fog.$description: Dim Fog — Inactive icons, subtle separators, tertiary interface details

ultraviolet-core.$description: Ultraviolet Core — Primary accent, active links, luminous highlights — saturated violet against the black-violet canvas creates the site’s underlit glow

lilac-beam.$description: Lilac Beam — Gradient flare, line effects, ambient glow edges — used as the cooler top note inside purple light blooms

horizon-glow.$description: Horizon Glow — Gradient midpoint and visual hotspot — the brighter violet that makes hero illumination feel energized instead of flat

glass-white-04.$description: Glass White 04 — Tinted fills for ghost pills, badge backgrounds, translucent overlays

glass-white-10.$description: Glass White 10 — Hairline borders on pills and glass panels

ultraviolet-horizon.$description: Ultraviolet Horizon — Hero light field, illuminated dividers, ambient section glow

violet-beam.$description: Violet Beam — Brighter line and halo treatments where the glow should read crisp instead of misty

deep-fade-veil.$description: Deep Fade Veil — Section overlays and bottom fades that darken content without breaking the purple atmosphere

inter-v.$description: System font for navigation, body copy, links, buttons, badges, inputs, and smaller headings. The custom build is doing more than a stock Inter install: disabled standard ligature behavior plus alternate stylistic sets make the text feel slightly engineered rather than default SaaS. Use 400 for body, 500 for controls and links, 700 for compact emphasis; apply tighter tracking at larger UI sizes and the wide tracking only for utility-style labels.

rebond-grotesque.$description: Display and headline font for hero statements and major section titles. The heavier serifless grotesque gives Wope its large-scale voice: broad, compact, and slightly formal, which keeps the glowing purple environment from feeling playful. Use only for headline moments, not for buttons or dense UI.
